prompts.prompt: Without tuning, what false-positive rate range do enterprise SAST tools like Checkmarx and Veracode typically exhibit? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/sast/SKILL.md - Enterprise tools (Checkmarx, Veracode) typically see 30-50% FP rates without tuning

prompts.prompt: What false-positive rate threshold is recommended as a tuning target for SAST findings that gate a CI/CD pipeline merge? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/sast/SKILL.md - Practical balance: tune to less than 20% FP rate for gated findings

prompts.prompt: Name two specific secure-coding techniques that SAST tools treat as sanitizers, which break the taint chain and thereby reduce injection-vulnerability false positives. Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/sast/SKILL.md - Sanitizers: parameterized queries / prepared statements, output encoding (HTML, URL, JavaScript)
